facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa states that Starlink (SpaceX) launched commercial operations in Benin at the end of 2023; talks with government on a partnership were preliminary and no agreement was signed.
MyBroadband's Starlink status table of 17 July 2026 lists Benin as 'Available' for Starlink (SpaceX).
TechnoMag lists Benin among the 26 countries where Starlink is 'Active Now' as of mid-2026 (article date 2026-06-29, no other date given).
Le360 lists Benin among 29 African countries that had granted Starlink a licence as of May 2026; it gives no licence date or issuing body for Benin.

Techs Togo names Benin among the first West African countries to get Starlink, with users able to subscribe at 30,000 FCFA a month plus 400,000 FCFA for equipment and 15,000 FCFA shipping (article date 2025-01-14, no other date given).

Starlink is listed by ARCEP Benin among the operators with fixed internet subscriptions in Benin, with 2,550 subscriptions at 31 March 2026 (1,013 at Q2 2025, 1,593 at Q3 2025, 2,215 at Q4 2025), and satellite is 1.99% of the fixed internet base.
Subscribers: 2,550 at 2026-03-31, per ARCEP Benin (Starlink, in the fixed internet subscriptions table of the Observatoire de l'Internet).

A survey of 12 African markets in January 2025, reported by TechCabal Insights, found local providers in Benin cheaper than Starlink, implying Starlink was priced for sale in Benin; no launch or licence is stated.

note: Pan-African story; the only statement naming Benin is the January 2025 price comparison.

ARCEP decision 2024-108 (11 April 2024) sets conditions for non-terrestrial network service providers and lists the fields of an online registry; the passages name no provider, licence or sale, so no fact (framework only).

facts.fact: ARCEP Benin's internet observatory lists Starlink among fixed internet operators with 1,013 subscriptions at 30 June 2025.
ARCEP Benin's quarterly internet observatory publishes Starlink's subscriber count, 1,013 at 30 June 2025.
ARCEP Benin's register of authorised internet access providers dated 30 September 2025 lists Starlink Benin SARL as authorised for all 77 communes.

note: No licence or sale of satellite broadband stated for Benin.
The document states nothing on satellite broadband.
